systems.platform: a national geospatial platform into which digitised addressing data is to be integrated
systems.owner: Commission nationale d'adressage, ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités locales et des Transports
systems.tiers: commune and daïra staff of the wilaya of Timimoun trained, May 2026; Timimoun the first of six wilayas programmed for 2026 after pilots in Alger, Oran, Constantine, Ouargla, Bouira and Sidi Bel-Abbès; more than 110 million dinars from the local authorities' 2026 operating budget

note: Commune and daïra staff in Timimoun were trained to digitise addressing data for a national geospatial platform before the register's launch there; the document does not say their offices are connected or yet work in it.
